concept.zh: 保持两路顺序的合流计数

brief.zh: 两台电台分别给出字符序列 a 和 b。每拍可取任一电台尚未发出的首个字符。要恰好发完两路并拼出 tape，有多少种选择电台的顺序？相同字符来自不同台也算不同选择。无法拼出返回 0，三串都为空返回 1。
brief.en: Stations A and B hold the strings a and b. At each beat, take the next character from either station. Count station-choice sequences that consume both entire strings and emit exactly tape. Matching characters from different stations still give different choices. Return 0 when impossible and 1 when all strings are empty.

label.zh: 核对 A 台上一拍
label.en: Check the last character from A

label.zh: 检查总长度并布置计数表
label.en: Check lengths and prepare a count table

label.zh: 同拍两台均匹配时优先 A 台
label.en: Prefer A when both channels match

snippets.code:
if j > 0 and b[j - 1] == tape[k] and (i == 0 or a[i - 1] != tape[k]):
                paths[i][j] += paths[i][j - 1]

label.zh: 核对 B 台上一拍
label.en: Check the last character from B

snippets.code:
if j > 0 and b[j - 1] == tape[k]:
                paths[i][j] += paths[i][j - 1]
